<?php
class InvokeBase218 { public $tag=9; public function __destruct() { echo "THIS-END;"; } public function __invoke($saved,$ignored) { echo "INVOKE:",self::class,":",static::class,";"; return $saved; } }
class InvokeScope218 extends InvokeBase218 { public function run() { global $owner,$argument; return $owner->MiSsInG($this($argument,shift218())); } } class InvokeChild218 extends InvokeScope218 {}
function shift218() { $GLOBALS["argument"]=new New218; $GLOBALS["owner"]=null; $GLOBALS["runner"]=null; echo "SHIFT;"; return false; }
class Old218 { public function __destruct() { echo "OLD;"; } } class New218 { public function __destruct() { echo "NEW;"; } }
class Magic218 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { $GLOBALS["argument"]=null; echo "HANDLER:",($arguments[0] instanceof Old218)?"OLD;":"BAD;"; return false; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$argument=new Old218; $owner=new Magic218; $runner=new InvokeChild218; $result=$runner->run(); echo "RETURN;"; echo $result===false?"AFTER;":"BAD;";

<?php
class ZeroBase218 { public $tag=9; public function run() { global $owner; return $owner->MiSsInG(first:$this(),later:7); } public function __destruct() { echo "THIS-END;"; } }
class ZeroChild218 extends ZeroBase218 { public function __invoke() { $GLOBALS["runner"]=null; echo "CHILD;"; return $this; } }
class ZeroMagic218 { public function __call(string $name,array $arguments) { $GLOBALS["owner"]=null; echo "HANDLER:",($arguments["first"] instanceof ZeroChild218 && $arguments["later"]===7)?"SELF;":"BAD;"; return false; } public function __destruct() { echo "OWNER;"; } }
$owner=new ZeroMagic218; $runner=new ZeroChild218; $result=$runner->run(); echo "RETURN;"; echo $result===false?"AFTER;":"BAD;";
